title_sq: Super ap 2+1 tek rruga bardhyl ( existus ) buz rruge
description_sq:
Shitet apartamenti 2+1 buze rruges bardhyl ( unaz e vogel)
Ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati kater kac.
Apartamenti eshte pershtatur si 1+1 me guzhin me vete.

Cmimi i shitjes 128k.
( apartamenti do te jete ne shitje deri me dt.16.02.2026 pasi me pas do fillojn restaurimet)
title_en: Super ap 2+1 on Bardhyl street (existus) street edge
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on the edge of Bardhyl street (small ring) It is located on the 3rd floor of a four-story building. The apartment is adapted as 1+1 with its own kitchen.
